1479-2692-5700-5701-8345.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-2692-5700-5701-8345.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Felidar Retreat trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Felidar Retreat trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield untapped as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Felidar Retreat triggers.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Felidar Retreat trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Felidar Retreat triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

339-677-3899-8296.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Jegantha, putting a charge counter on Spawning Pit
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

728-2113-3249-3621.easyPrerequisites:
Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
Karametra's Favor attached to Grimgrin.
728-2113-3249-3621.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Su-Chi Cave Guard, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard dies, it triggers, adding mana equal to its casting cost.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Karametra's Favor by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Su-Chi Cave Guard from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Su-Chi Cave Guard from your graveyard by paying its casting cost.
Repeat.

4871-5220-5849-8095.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
4871-5220-5849-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

1368-6321-6633-7763.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-6321-6633-7763.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

6797-6972-7724.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Wakandan Royal Guard.
When Wakandan Royal Guard dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Wakandan Royal Guard enters, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

2438-2730-5987.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Angel of Indemnity.
When Angel of Indemnity dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Angel of Indemnity from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Angel of Indemnity enters, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Angel of Indemnity
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

277-3875-5702-6973.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
277-3875-5702-6973.description:
Play a land.
When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Mutable Explorer.
When the Mutable Explorer token enters, it triggers, creating a Mutavault land token that enters tapped.
When the Mutavault token enters, Springheart Nantuko, Tiller Engine and Tireless Provisioner trigger.
Resolve the Tiller Engine trigger, untapping the Mutavault token.
Holding priority, activate the Mutavault token by tapping it, adding {C}.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Holding priority, activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Mutable Explorer.
Repeat from step 3.

2034-4985-5224-6294.description:
Cast Marketback Walker by paying {1}, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Marketback Walker.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Marketback Walker, adding {C}{C}.
When Marketback Walker dies, it and Together Forever trigger.
Resolve the Marketback Walker trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Together Forever trigger, returning Marketback Walker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

413-3560-6888.description:
Cast Traveling Plague by paying {3}{B}{B}, attaching it to another creature you control.
When Traveling Plague enters, Archon of Sun's Grace triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by sacrificing the creature Traveling Plague is attached to.
When the creature dies, Traveling Plague triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the token created in step 2.
Repeat steps 2 and 3 one additional time.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 4.

2457-3000-4772-5794.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect and two 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
Activate Baylen's first ability twice by tapping the Squirrel and Insect tokens, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

1563-2457-3000-4068.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
1563-2457-3000-4068.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

1069-1232-3499-5499.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
1069-1232-3499-5499.description:
Activate Nemata's first ability by paying {2}{G}, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Saproling.
Activate the Saproling by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

2060-2921-3054-6701.easyPrerequisites: You have gained life this turn.
2060-2921-3054-6701.description:
Cast Oathsworn Vampire from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Oathsworn Vampire.
When Oathsworn Vampire is sacrificed, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters equal to Szarel's power on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {B}.
Repeat.
2060-2921-3054-6701.notes: This combo can put infinite +1/+1 counters on each creature you control except Szarel so long as its power is greater than the mana value of the card in your graveyard.

687-2438-4929-5641-5684.notablePrerequisites: If Carrion Feeder is in your graveyard, you must have {3} available and three removable counters from creatures you control, ensuring to leave a +1/+1 counter on Cryptic Trilobite and Basking Broodscale. If Carrion Feeder is in your hand, you must have enough mana to cast it.
687-2438-4929-5641-5684.description:
Cast Carrion Feeder by paying its mana cost if it is in your hand. Otherwise, activate Tayam by paying {3} and removing three counters from creatures you control, causing you to mill three cards and return Carrion Feeder from your graveyard to the battlefield with a vigilance counter on it.
When Carrion Feeder enters the battlefield, Metastatic Evangel triggers, causing you to put a +1/+1 counter on Cryptic Trilobite and Basking Broodscale and a vigilance counter on Carrion Feeder.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token that enters with a vigilance counter on it.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Activate Tayam by paying {3}, removing both vigilance counters from Carrion Feeder and another counter from a creature you control.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing it.
Resolve the Tayam ability, causing you to mill three cards and return Carrion Feeder from your graveyard to the battlefield with a vigilance counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.
Repeat.
687-2438-4929-5641-5684.notes: If you do not control any other creatures, you may instead activate Tayam before sacrificing the Eldrazi Spawn, thus using the Eldrazi Spawn's vigilance counter as the third counter for activation. Doing this will add {1} to the mana needed for the combo.

uses.n: Emet-Selch, Unsundered // Hades, Sorcerer of Eld

requires.n: Extra Turn Spell - GY on Resolution

2072-6333--88.notablePrerequisites:
You have enough mana to cast the extra turn spell and Scrollshift each turn.
There are at least thirteen cards in your graveyard.
2072-6333--88.description:
Cast the extra turn spell from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Scrollshift from your graveyard by paying its mana cost, blinking Hades and causing it to re-enter the battlefield as Emet-Selch.
When Emet-Selch enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to loot.
Resolve the extra turn spell, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your upkeep during your extra turn, Emet-Selch triggers, transforming itself into Hades.
Repeat.
2072-6333--88.notes: You must use an extra turn spell that will be put into your graveyard as it resolves, not exile or shuffling into your library.

678-4766-5147.easyPrerequisites: Deathrender attached to a nontoken creature you control.
678-4766-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the creature with Deathrender attached.
When the creature dies, Enduring Renewal and Deathrender trigger.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Deathrender trigger, putting the creature from your hand onto the battlefield, and attaching Deathrender to it.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of the legendary creature.

3039-3258-4450-5361.description:
Cast Beacon of Tomorrows by paying {6}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and shuffle Beacon of Tomorrows into your library.
Activate Liliana Vess's second loyalty ability by removing zero loyalty counters from it, searching your library for Beacon of Tomorrows, then shuffling your library and putting it on top.
Move to your next turn, drawing Beacon of Tomorrows during your draw step.
Repeat.

2724-3582-3987-4050.description:
Activate Kaya the Inexorable's first ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, putting a ghostform counter on Wormfang Manta.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Wormfang Manta, adding {U}.
When Wormfang Manta dies, its second ability and its ghostform ability trigger.
Resolve the ghostform trigger, returning Wormfang Manta from your graveyard to your hand and creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Resolve the second trigger, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Wormfang Manta by paying {5}{U}{U}.
Wormfang Manta's first ability does not trigger due to Torpor Orb.
Repeat each turn.

1684-2178-2757-5147.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Rakka Mar.
You control at least one basic Mountain.
1684-2178-2757-5147.description:
Activate a basic Mountain by tapping it, adding {R}.
Activate Rakka Mar by paying {R} and tapping it, creating a 3/1 Elemental creature token with haste.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the Elemental, untapping the Mountain.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the Elemental.
When the Elemental dies, Rakka Mar triggers, untapping Rakka Mar.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

1124-1636-2034-4091-5082.notablePrerequisites: Aphetto Alchemist does not have summoning sickness.
1124-1636-2034-4091-5082.description:
Activate Garruk's first loyalty ability by putting zero loyalty counters on it, creating two 2/2 Wolf creature tokens.
When the Wolfs enter the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping all creatures.
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, untapping The Chain Veil.
Resolve the second Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, untapping target artifact or creature.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the two Wolf tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When the Wolves die, they trigger, putting two loyalty counters on each Garruk planeswalker you control.
Activate The Chain Veil by paying {4} and tapping it, allowing you an additional activation of your planeswalkers' loyalty abilities this turn.
Repeat.

175-3028-3525.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Avid Reclaimer.
Avid Reclaimer does not have summoning sickness.
175-3028-3525.description:
Activate Avid Reclaimer by tapping it, adding {U} and causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Avid Reclaimer.
Repeat.

342-577-1867-3080.description:
Cast Exchange of Words by paying {1}{U}{U}.
When Exhcange of Words enters the battlefield, it triggers, switching the text boxes of Soldevi Simulacrum and Vegetation Abomination.
Activate Vegetation Abomination by paying {0}, giving itself +1/+0 until end of turn.
Repeat step 3.

1105-1331-5157.notablePrerequisites:
Scythe of the Wretched attached to Orchard Strider.
You control at least two Foods.
1105-1331-5157.description:
Activate Asmoranomardicadaistinaculdacar by sacrificing two Foods, causing Orchard Strider to deal six damage to itself.
Orchard Strider dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Scythe of the Wretched triggers, returning Orchard Strider from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Scythe of the Wretched to it.
When Orchard Strider enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating two Food tokens.
Repeat.

1636-2243-4694.notablePrerequisites: Glittermonger does not have summoning sickness.
1636-2243-4694.description:
Activate Glittermonger by tapping it, creating a Treasure token.
The Treasure token enters the battlefield as a 0/0 artifact creature, and therefore dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

1955-3492-3609.notablePrerequisites:
Coretapper and Eternal Taskmaster do not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block and kill Eternal Taskmaster.
1955-3492-3609.description:
Activate Coretapper's first ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Coretapper's second ability by sacrificing it, putting two charge counters on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, taking an extra turn after this one.
Declare Eternal Taskmaster as an attacker.
Eternal Taskmaster triggers, causing you to pay {2}{B} to return Coretapper from your graveyard to your hand.
In your postcombat main phase, cast Coretapper by paying {2}.
Repeat each turn.

1671-3525-4644.notablePrerequisites:
Tidewater Minion does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Tidewater Minion.
1671-3525-4644.description:
Activate Simic Growth Chamber by tapping it, adding {U}{G}.
Activate Tidewater Minion's last ability by tapping it, untapping Simic Growth Chamber.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Tidewater Minion.
Repeat any number of times.
